sql:
SELECT status, MIN(shipping_fee) AS min_shipping_fee
FROM orders
WHERE channel IN ('mobile', 'store', 'partner') AND MONTH(order_date) IN (4, 7, 9)
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("channel").isin(["mobile", "store", "partner"]) & F.month("order_date").isin([4, 7, 9]))
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(F.min("shipping_fee").alias("min_shipping_fee"))
    .orderBy("status")
)

sql: SELECT i.id, i.store_id, i.product_id, ss.units, COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled FROM inventory i LEFT OUTER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE i.quantity <= 71 AND ss.product_id IN (6, 9);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ss"), (F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("ss.store_id")) & (F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("ss.product_id")), "left")
    .filter((F.col("i.quantity") <= 71) & F.col("ss.product_id").isin([6, 9]))
    .select(
        F.col("i.id"),
        F.col("i.store_id"),
        F.col("i.product_id"),
        F.col("ss.units"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("i.quantity"), F.lit(0)).alias("quantity_filled"),
    )
)

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN departments.budget >= 3352000 THEN 'high' WHEN departments.budget >= 779000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket,
    CASE WHEN departments.dept_name IN ('Marketing', 'Engineering') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END AS dept_name_group,
    MIN(employees.salary) AS min_salary,
    MAX(employees.salary) - MIN(employees.salary) AS salary_range
FROM employees
RIGHT JOIN departments ON departments.id = employees.dept_id
WHERE departments.budget BETWEEN 3465000 AND 3626000
GROUP BY CASE WHEN departments.budget >= 3352000 THEN 'high' WHEN departments.budget >= 779000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN departments.dept_name IN ('Marketing', 'Engineering') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END
ORDER BY budget_bucket, salary_range;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_employees.alias("employees")
    .join(df_departments.alias("departments"), F.col("departments.id") == F.col("employees.dept_id"), "right")
    .filter(F.col("departments.budget").between(3465000, 3626000))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("departments.budget") >= 3352000, "high").when(F.col("departments.budget") >= 779000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("departments.dept_name").isin(["Marketing", "Engineering"]), "priority").otherwise("other").alias("dept_name_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min(F.col("employees.salary")).alias("min_salary"),
        (F.max(F.col("employees.salary")) - F.min(F.col("employees.salary"))).alias("salary_range"),
    )
    .orderBy("budget_bucket", "salary_range")
)

WITH recent_payments AS (
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(status, 1, 4) AS status_prefix
    FROM payments
    WHERE method NOT IN ('promptpay', 'bank_transfer', 'card') AND method IN ('card', 'promptpay', 'cash')
),

    FROM recent_payments
    GROUP BY method

code:

recent_payments = (
    df_payments
    .filter(~F.col("method").isin(["promptpay", "bank_transfer", "card"]) & F.col("method").isin(["card", "promptpay", "cash"]))
    .withColumn("status_prefix", F.substring("status", 1, 4))
)

agg = (
    recent_payments
    .groupBy("method")
    .agg(F.avg("amount").alias("avg_amount"))
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("avg_amount") < 590)

WITH recent_store_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (1, 2, 5, 9) AND (store_id IN (1, 2, 3, 5) OR revenue < 2200)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT store_id, MIN(sale_date) AS min_sale_date, MAX(units) - MIN(units) AS units_range
    FROM recent_store_sales
    GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT store_id, min_sale_date, units_range
FROM summary
WHERE units_range >= 40
ORDER BY store_id ASC, units_range DESC
LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([1, 2, 5, 9]) & (F.col("store_id").isin([1, 2, 3, 5]) | (F.col("revenue") < 2200)))
)

    recent_store_sales
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("sale_date").alias("min_sale_date"),
        (F.max("units") - F.min("units")).alias("units_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("units_range") >= 40)
    .select("store_id", "min_sale_date", "units_range")
    .orderBy("store_id", F.col("units_range").desc())
    .limit(10)
)

WITH Base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM web_events
    WHERE HOUR(event_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 13
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(event_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(event_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS event_cohort, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_click
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(event_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(event_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
)
SELECT *
FROM summary
ORDER BY event_cohort
LIMIT 5;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("event_time") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("event_time") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("event_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "click", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_click"),
    )
)

    .orderBy("event_cohort")

)

sql: WITH recent_subscriptions AS (SELECT *, FLOOR(monthly_fee) AS monthly_fee_whole FROM subscriptions WHERE status NOT IN ('PAUSED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')), end_quarter_summary AS (SELECT QUARTER(end_date) AS end_quarter, DATE_FORMAT(start_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS start_month, SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premium_count FROM recent_subscriptions GROUP BY QUARTER(end_date), DATE_FORMAT(start_date, 'yyyy-MM')) SELECT end_quarter, start_month, premium_count FROM end_quarter_summary WHERE premium_count > 35 ORDER BY 1 DESC, start_month LIMIT 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_subscriptions = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["PAUSED", "CANCELLED", "EXPIRED"]))
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_whole", F.floor("monthly_fee"))
)

end_quarter_summary = (
    recent_subscriptions
    .groupBy(
        F.quarter("end_date").alias("end_quarter"),
        F.date_format("start_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("start_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "premium", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("premium_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    end_quarter_summary
    .filter(F.col("premium_count") > 35)
    .select("end_quarter", "start_month", "premium_count")
    .orderBy(F.col("end_quarter").desc(), "start_month")
    .limit(3)
)

sql:
SELECT
    customers.country,
    COUNT(subscriptions.id) subscription_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(subscriptions.status)) status_list,
    ROUND(AVG(subscriptions.monthly_fee), 2) avg_monthly_fee
FROM customers
LEFT JOIN subscriptions ON subscriptions.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE subscriptions.customer_id IS NULL
GROUP BY customers.country;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_customers.alias("customers")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("subscriptions"), F.col("subscriptions.customer_id") == F.col("customers.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("subscriptions.customer_id").isNull())
    .groupBy(F.col("customers.country"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("subscriptions.id")).alias("subscription_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set(F.col("subscriptions.status"))).alias("status_list"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("subscriptions.monthly_fee")), 2).alias("avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

sql:
select
    case when stores.sqft >= 14057 then 'high' when stores.sqft >= 6598 then 'mid' else 'low' end as sqft_bucket,
    stores.city,
    sort_array(collect_set(orders.channel)) as channel_list,
    count(distinct orders.shipping_fee) as unique_statuss
from orders
join stores on stores.id = orders.store_id
join customers on customers.id = orders.customer_id
where stores.region not in ('Central', 'North')
group by case when stores.sqft >= 14057 then 'high' when stores.sqft >= 6598 then 'mid' else 'low' end, stores.city
having count(distinct orders.shipping_fee) >= 2
order by sqft_bucket, unique_statuss desc, city
limit 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders.alias("orders")
    .join(df_stores.alias("stores"), F.col("stores.id") == F.col("orders.store_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_customers.alias("customers"), F.col("customers.id") == F.col("orders.customer_id"), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("stores.region").isin(["Central", "North"]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 14057, "high").when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 6598, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
        F.col("stores.city"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set(F.col("orders.channel"))).alias("channel_list"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("orders.shipping_fee")).alias("unique_statuss"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("unique_statuss") >= 2)
    .orderBy("sqft_bucket", F.col("unique_statuss").desc(), "city")
    .limit(1)
)

    CASE WHEN rating >= 4.5 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 2.0 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END rating_bucket,
    COUNT(rating) rating_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'London' THEN 1 END) london_count,
    ROUND(STDDEV(rating), 2) stddev_rating
FROM suppliers
WHERE country = 'UK' AND supplier_name IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
HAVING ROUND(STDDEV(rating), 2) >= 30
ORDER BY rating_bucket, london_count DESC
LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter((F.col("country") == "UK") & F.col("supplier_name").isNull())
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.5, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 2.0, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("rating").alias("rating_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1)).alias("london_count"),
        F.round(F.stddev("rating"), 2).alias("stddev_rating"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("stddev_rating") >= 30)
    .orderBy("rating_bucket", F.col("london_count").desc())
    .limit(10)
)

SELECT YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(brand))) AS brand_values, MAX(price) AS max_price
FROM products
WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(tags, 'sale') AND stock_qty <> 197
GROUP BY launch_year
ORDER BY brand_values
code:

    df_products
    .filter(F.array_contains("tags", "sale") & (F.col("stock_qty") != 197))

    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand"))).alias("brand_values"),
        F.max("price").alias("max_price"),
    )
    .orderBy("brand_values")
)

FROM customers

sql:
select
    case when status in ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') then 'group_a' else 'other' end as status_group,
    channel,
    max(shipping_fee) - min(shipping_fee) as shipping_fee_range,
    max(amount) - min(amount) as amount_range
from orders
where shipping_fee < 13
group by status_group, channel
having max(shipping_fee) - min(shipping_fee) > 22
order by 1 desc, channel
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("shipping_fee") < 13)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status").isin(["CANCELLED", "RETURNED"]), "group_a").otherwise("other").alias("status_group"),
        "channel",
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max("shipping_fee") - F.min("shipping_fee")).alias("shipping_fee_range"),
        (F.max("amount") - F.min("amount")).alias("amount_range"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("shipping_fee_range") > 22)
    .orderBy(F.col("status_group").desc(), "channel")
)

sql: select case when event_type in ('purchase', 'click') then 'priority' else 'other' end as event_type_group, count(*) as web_event_count, round((100 * sum(case when page = '/product' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_product from web_events where duration_sec <> 423 group by case when event_type in ('purchase', 'click') then 'priority' else 'other' end having count(*) < 4 order by web_event_count desc, event_type_group;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") != 423)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("event_type").isin(["purchase", "click"]), "priority").otherwise("other").alias("event_type_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("web_event_count"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_product"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("web_event_count") < 4)
    .orderBy(F.col("web_event_count").desc(), "event_type_group")
)

SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS order_cohort,
    MAX(discount) AS max_discount
FROM orders
WHERE discount < 0.21
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING MAX(discount) >= 0.38
ORDER BY customer_id
code:

    )
    .agg(F.max("discount").alias("max_discount"))
    .filter(F.col("max_discount") >= 0.38)
    .orderBy("customer_id")
)

sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status, shipping_fee, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount, LAST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_amount FROM orders WHERE amount BETWEEN 690 AND 720;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)

    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("amount").between(690, 720))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_date",
        "amount",
        "status",

        F.sum("amount").over(w).alias("running_amount"),
        F.last("amount").over(w2).alias("last_amount"),
    )
)

)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM stores
    WHERE region = 'Central' AND LOWER(store_name) LIKE '%all%' AND region = 'Central'
),
region_summary AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(sqft) AS avg_sqft, SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'London' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS london_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT *
FROM region_summary
WHERE london_count > 73
ORDER BY london_count
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("region") == "Central") & F.lower("store_name").like("%all%") & (F.col("region") == "Central"))
)

region_summary = (
    base
    .groupBy("region")
    .agg(
        F.avg("sqft").alias("avg_sqft"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("london_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    region_summary
    .filter(F.col("london_count") > 73)
    .orderBy("london_count")
)

FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
RIGHT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(s.opened_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(s.opened_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END

LIMIT 1;

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year(F.col("s.opened_date")) < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year(F.col("s.opened_date")) == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("opened_cohort"),

with base as (

    from products
    where brand is null and supplier_id = 32
),
launch_cohort_summary as (
    select case when year(launch_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(launch_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end launch_cohort, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(brand))) brand_values
    from base
    group by case when year(launch_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(launch_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end
)
select launch_cohort, brand_values
from launch_cohort_summary
order by brand_values desc

        F.when(F.year("launch_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("launch_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("launch_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand"))).alias("brand_values"))

)

    YEAR(sale_date) sale_year,
    CASE WHEN units >= 39 THEN 'high' WHEN units >= 7 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END units_bucket,
    MAX(sale_date) latest_sale_date,
    COUNT(revenue) revenue_count,
    COUNT(*) total_count

ORDER BY total_count;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_store_sales
    .groupBy(
        F.year("sale_date").alias("sale_year"),
        F.when(F.col("units") >= 39, "high").when(F.col("units") >= 7, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("units_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("sale_date").alias("latest_sale_date"),

    CASE WHEN quantity >= 261 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 119 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket,

    COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS unique_stores

    CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 403 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 202 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS duration_sec_bucket,
    ROUND(STDDEV(duration_sec), 2) AS stddev_duration_sec,
    SUM(duration_sec) AS total_duration_sec
FROM web_events
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING stddev_duration_sec >= 59
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_web_events
    .groupBy(
        "event_type",
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 403, "high").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 202, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("duration_sec"), 2).alias("stddev_duration_sec"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").alias("total_duration_sec"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("stddev_duration_sec") >= 59)
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE store_id IN (1, 5) OR product_id IN (1, 6, 8)), Summary AS (SELECT YEAR(last_restock) AS last_restock_year, QUARTER(last_restock) AS last_restock_quarter, MIN(last_restock) AS min_last_restock, MIN(last_restock) AS first_last_restock FROM base GROUP BY YEAR(last_restock), QUARTER(last_restock)) SELECT last_restock_year, last_restock_quarter, min_last_restock, first_last_restock FROM Summary ORDER BY first_last_restock DESC, last_restock_quarter DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 5]) | F.col("product_id").isin([1, 6, 8]))
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.year("last_restock").alias("last_restock_year"),
        F.quarter("last_restock").alias("last_restock_quarter"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("last_restock").alias("min_last_restock"),
        F.min("last_restock").alias("first_last_restock"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "last_restock_year",
        "last_restock_quarter",
        "min_last_restock",
        "first_last_restock",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("first_last_restock").desc(), F.col("last_restock_quarter").desc())
)

sql: SELECT status, CASE WHEN balance >= 79000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 11000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END balance_bucket, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) closed_count FROM accounts WHERE status IN ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN', 'OPEN') AND (balance <= 20000 OR balance < 42000) GROUP BY status, balance_bucket HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) >= 5 ORDER BY status, balance_bucket LIMIT 50;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["CLOSED", "FROZEN", "OPEN"]) & ((F.col("balance") <= 20000) | (F.col("balance") < 42000)))
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("balance") >= 79000, "high").when(F.col("balance") >= 11000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("balance_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "CLOSED", 1)).alias("closed_count"))
    .filter(F.col("closed_count") >= 5)
    .orderBy("status", "balance_bucket")
    .limit(50)
)

sql: WITH recent_inventory AS (SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(last_restock, 12) AS last_restock_plus_months FROM inventory WHERE last_restock <= '2024-05-01'), agg AS (SELECT QUARTER(last_restock_plus_months) AS last_restock_plus_months_quarter, COUNT(*) AS num_inventory, MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range FROM recent_inventory GROUP BY QUARTER(last_restock_plus_months)) SELECT last_restock_plus_months_quarter, num_inventory, quantity_range FROM agg WHERE quantity_range > 50;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_inventory = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") <= "2024-05-01")
    .withColumn("last_restock_plus_months", F.add_months("last_restock", 12))
)

agg = (
    recent_inventory
    .groupBy(
        F.quarter("last_restock_plus_months").alias("last_restock_plus_months_quarter"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_inventory"),
        (F.max("quantity") - F.min("quantity")).alias("quantity_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("quantity_range") > 50)
    .select("last_restock_plus_months_quarter", "num_inventory", "quantity_range")
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(customers.signup_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(customers.signup_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS signup_cohort, CASE WHEN customers.country IN ('JP', 'UK') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END AS country_group, COUNT(CASE WHEN subscriptions.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_count, MAX(subscriptions.monthly_fee) - MIN(subscriptions.monthly_fee) AS monthly_fee_range FROM subscriptions INNER JOIN customers ON subscriptions.customer_id = customers.id GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(customers.signup_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(customers.signup_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, CASE WHEN customers.country IN ('JP', 'UK') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY signup_cohort
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions.alias("subscriptions")
    .join(df_customers.alias("customers"), F.col("subscriptions.customer_id") == F.col("customers.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year(F.col("customers.signup_date")) < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year(F.col("customers.signup_date")) == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("signup_cohort"),
        F.when(F.col("customers.country").isin(["JP", "UK"]), "tier_1").otherwise("other").alias("country_group"),

        (F.max(F.col("subscriptions.monthly_fee")) - F.min(F.col("subscriptions.monthly_fee"))).alias("monthly_fee_range"),

sql: with src as (select *, datediff(current_date(), last_restock) as days_since_last_restock from inventory where month(last_restock) in (4, 9, 10) and quantity between 208 and 238 and quantity > 193), summary as (select case when days_since_last_restock >= 60 then 'high' when days_since_last_restock >= 30 then 'mid' else 'low' end as days_since_last_restock_bucket, case when quantity >= 262 then 'high' when quantity >= 113 then 'mid' else 'low' end as quantity_bucket, min(last_restock) as first_last_restock from src group by case when days_since_last_restock >= 60 then 'high' when days_since_last_restock >= 30 then 'mid' else 'low' end, case when quantity >= 262 then 'high' when quantity >= 113 then 'mid' else 'low' end) select * from summary order by first_last_restock, days_since_last_restock_bucket desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.month("last_restock").isin([4, 9, 10]) & F.col("quantity").between(208, 238) & (F.col("quantity") > 193))
    .withColumn("days_since_last_restock", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock"))
)

summary = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("days_since_last_restock") >= 60, "high").when(F.col("days_since_last_restock") >= 30, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("days_since_last_restock_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 262, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 113, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.min("last_restock").alias("first_last_restock"))
)

result = (
    summary
    .orderBy("first_last_restock", F.col("days_since_last_restock_bucket").desc())
)

sql: SELECT stores.region, ROUND(AVG(store_sales.revenue), 2) AS avg_revenue FROM store_sales INNER JOIN products ON products.id = store_sales.product_id INNER JOIN stores ON store_sales.store_id = stores.id WHERE YEAR(stores.opened_date) = 2025 GROUP BY stores.region
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_store_sales.alias("store_sales")
    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("products.id") == F.col("store_sales.product_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_stores.alias("stores"), F.col("store_sales.store_id") == F.col("stores.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.year(F.col("stores.opened_date")) == 2025)
    .groupBy(F.col("stores.region"))
    .agg(F.round(F.avg(F.col("store_sales.revenue")), 2).alias("avg_revenue"))
)

sql: select s.city, min(i.last_restock) min_last_restock, min(i.last_restock) first_last_restock from inventory i inner join stores s on s.id = i.store_id where year(s.opened_date) >= 2023 group by s.city
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("i.store_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.year(F.col("s.opened_date")) >= 2023)
    .groupBy(F.col("s.city"))

FROM order_items
WHERE unit_price <= 400
ORDER BY id DESC, product_id DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("unit_price") <= 400)
    .withColumn("least_unit_price_quantity", F.least("unit_price", "quantity"))
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc(), F.col("product_id").desc())
)

sql: select id, txn_time, account_id, round(amount, 0) as amount_rounded from transactions where txn_type in ('DEBIT', 'FEE', 'REFUND') and is_flagged = true and txn_type = 'FEE' order by txn_time desc, amount_rounded desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
